messages:
maria_sales: Quick alert  OrbitHealth wants a 2-week POC for Zephyr-13B-compact (customer-repacked quant) to validate summarization + redaction. They asked if we can run on Dedicated and later move to Private. Need onboarding checklist + delta pricing for quantized repack vs fp16.

kevin_infra: I can take infra. Two quick things: (1) is the artifact already in our supported packaging (ggml/transformer format), (2) expected max seq len? we need to size GPU mem.

maria_sales: Artifact URL (customer): https://orbithealth.artifacts/zephyr/13b/compact/artifact.tar.gz. They expect seq up to 1024, typical 512.

tara_solutions: For compatibility: ask them if the repack uses 3bit-packed or grouped-int4. We support grouped-int4 kernels; 3bit-packed falls back to generic matmul which increases latency. If they send a grouped-int4 tarball, onboarding is low-risk.

li_research: To add: quantized repacks can have subtle behavior on extraction/redaction. Recommend a small eval (n=300) focused on PII redaction. Also supply checksums + model provenance before we accept artifact.

security_eng: Enterprise checklist: SOC2 or equivalent, SSF, and model provenance hash. Also confirm if they need CMK for storing the artifact + KMS for telemetry. Send them this link: https://redwood.app/sec/presales-check.

maria_sales: They want CMK for artifacts and customer data retention rules (no embeddings stored >7d). Legal asked if we support per-tenant KV isolation + TTL.

kevin_infra: Yes, Dedicated supports tenant KV namespaces with per-tenant TTL and purge-on-demand. We'll need the tenant id and the artifact checksum. Also need to know if they want persistent KV across restarts.

maria_sales: I'll get tenant id + checksum. Can you draft minimal onboarding config to forward?

kevin_infra: Minimal config (send as inline):
```
model: zephyr-13b-compact
variant: grouped-int4  # prefer this, else expect perf fallback
max_sequence: 1024
kv_cache: tenant_scoped
kv_persistence: ephemeral|persistent  # choose
cmk_required: true
retention_policy: embeddings_ttl=7d
sla_target: p95<200ms@1concurrency
```
If they choose 3bit-packed, note the fallback perf in quote.

tara_solutions: Pricing note: for Dedicated POC we do node-hour + discounted reserved baseline + metered tokens. If grouped-int4 works, cost goes down ~30% vs fp16; if fallback used (3bit), add a performance uplift fee. I'll prep numbers with finance.

maria_sales: Li, can you outline the eval set spec to ask OrbitHealth for redaction tests?

li_research: Sure  send 300 examples: 200 standard redaction cases, 50 edge ambiguous PII, 50 adversarial redaction prompts. Provide labels and expected redaction spans. We'll run A/B int4 vs fp16 if they can provide both variants.

audit-bot: scan-staging: model-compatibility job created (id: 99321). Queue position: 2.

kevin_infra: Kicking off the scan once the artifact lands in our staging bucket. Ill post memory profile, kernel flags, and a rough single-turn p95 in ~90-120 minutes.

maria_sales: Great. I'll ask OrbitHealth for grouped-int4 artifact, checksum, CMK confirmation, and the eval set. Security, please send the presales checklist link to them. :pray:
